headline: Sinopec Third-Quarter Profit Jumps 64% on Higher Oil Prices
summary: China Petroleum & Chemical Corporation reported a 63.6% year-on-year surge in third-quarter net profit to $2 billion, supported by higher oil prices despite missing peak global refining margins.
why: As one of the world's largest energy and refining enterprises, Sinopec's earnings offer a broad indicator of Asian energy demand and downstream refining profitability.

impacts.name: Sinopec
impacts.why: Higher net profits driven by supportive commodity pricing directly enhance corporate earnings per share.
